proposals.title: The plan-level escalation reads only the LAST repair attempt's slot set, so a repair that proved the fix is a planning decision is recorded unrepairable
proposals.defect: SlotSetProbe.returned is one mutable field that every attempt overwrites, and conflicts compares only that one value. rounds.py:518 reads it after run_job has raised JobError - i.e. after BOTH attempts - so it sees only what the SECOND reply left behind. A first attempt that proved the fix belongs to planning is erased by a second attempt that does not.

attempt_1.sole_rejection: revised_output: the plan owns this section's slot set (...); a revision filling ... would add, drop, or re-choose a slot, which is a planning decision, not an authoring one
attempt_1.note: Schema, binding and stage checks all passed. The model dropped exactly the three subsections the finding names and nothing else. This is the escalation's documented trigger, met exactly.

attempt_2.rejection: revised_output.units[6].text: '' should be non-empty; units[7]; units[8]
attempt_2.note: Told by attempt 1's rejection that dropping a slot is a planning decision, the model complied by keeping all nine slots and emptying the three texts. minLength refused that, JobError was raised, and the probe now held the non-conflicting set.

measured_on_this_repository.consequence: rounds.py:518 read conflicts=False and fell through to rounds.py:521, repairs.record(..., 'unrepairable'). escalate_to_plan() never ran. repairs.json records outcome 'unrepairable', reason 'targeted_repair: output rejected twice; last rejection: revised_output.units[6].text: '' should be non-empty; ...', which names only the second attempt and leaves no trace that the first proved a planning decision.
replay_through_the_production_class_zero: state the escalation reads at rounds.py:518 (after attempt 2): False

proposals.why_the_existing_test_misses_it: tests/components/readme/repair/test_targeted.py:509 constructs a FRESH SlotSetProbe inside its own loop for each of kept/dropped/added, so it never exercises one probe across two attempts - the only shape production ever uses. The property under test is right; the fixture cannot see the defect. A mutation test belongs at the rounds.py level: two replies through one probe, conflict first, no conflict second, and escalate_to_plan must still run.
proposals.governance: project/loop-prompt.md section 6 rule 5 - never leave a permanent unrepairable finding blocking a candidate. Same shape as PROPOSAL E4: the routing information existed and the record withheld it. RESEARCH_AND_GUIDELINES.md section 27.2's 2026-09-05 decision built this escalation for exactly this case.
proposals.lane_e_recommends: Latch the conflict: make the probe remember that a conflict was EVER observed rather than only what the last reply returned, read by rounds.py:518 exactly as it is today. One field, one comparison.
lane_e_explicitly_does_not_propose: relaxing the minLength on unit text - an empty unit is not a deletion and should stay refused
letting S6 change the plan's slot set - the guard is right and is the whole point of section 27.2
a new blocking check for hub/table duplication - rule 14 wants a sealed defect, a mutation test and a subsumption review first, and the choice of module is the primary's
proposals.reversal_path: Revert the latch; the probe returns to last-reply semantics and this repository returns to unrepairable.

why_no_re_draw: Round 2 of this same run WAS the re-draw and is the measurement: every stage replayed from the call store with 0 provider calls ('model stored output reused') and the identical 11 findings re-raised - 'repair: 0 repaired, 1 unrepairable recorded advisory, 11 re-raised after repair; the equivalent failure stands; rounds 2'. A fresh present in a new process is keyed by the same request hashes and replays the same plan. Re-running until a composition happens to draw a plan without those three module hubs is selecting for a seal, not earning one (project/loop-prompt.md section 5's prohibition on a third equivalent attempt, and the lane's own standing note in project/lanes/lane-e.yaml).
